_comment: The XTX machine (docs/REFERENCE-MACHINES.md). Values that differ from OpenCore's Sample.plist, by stage. Each stage starts from the one named in 'inherits' and adds to it. SMBIOS serials are NOT here: build.py reads them from ~/.config/vermilion/smbios-<machine>.json.
name: ASUS ROG STRIX B650E-I + Ryzen 9 7900X3D + RX 7900 XTX
_dsdt_fix: BIOS 4005 defines GPP7.UP00.DP58 inside a module-level If and opens Scope(DP58) at the top level; macOS's 2016 ACPICA then rejects the whole DSDT (first boot, 2026-11-18). build.py fixes the machine's own dump (acpi-dump) with acpi/fix_dsdt.py.

acpi_quirks._RebaseRegions: the replaced DSDT has RAM regions (CPVS 0x733D9000, WPBR 0x733F0000) the firmware may move between boots; OpenCore relocates them by name (both unique).

booter_quirks._ResizeAppleGpuBars: 0 = macOS sees the GPU BARs at their default sizes (BAR0 256 MiB) while Resizable BAR stays on in the BIOS for Linux. Vermilion maps BAR0 as a VRAM window and was validated with 256 MiB (src/vermilion-boot/phx_core.cpp). OpenCore 1.0.8 accepts only -1 or 0 here.

_uefi_drivers: --preserve-boot: the picker's Reset NVRAM keeps the firmware boot entries (Limine, OpenCore). Without it a reset wiped them all on 2026-11-18.

install._comment: Phase 1 first boot and the macOS install: the fewest kexts that boot, SIP on, verbose.

base._comment: Phase 1 after the install: Wi-Fi, then the rest of the machine, one change per boot.

vermilion._comment: Phase 2: Vermilion (docs/INSTALL.md section 1). Needs build/VermilionBoot.kext from the macOS build host.
